Clicking the 'Start free trial' button now."}],"model":"claude-haiku-4-5","output_config":{"format":{"type":"json_schema","schema":{"$defs":{"FindingCategory":{"type":"string","enum":["blocker","confusion","missing_info","trust","pricing","delight"],"description":"Fixed taxonomy an Analyst classifies Findings into (spec §M4).","title":"FindingCategory"},"_RunAnalystFinding":{"type":"object","title":"_RunAnalystFinding","properties":{"category":{"$ref":"#/$defs/FindingCategory"},"severity":{"type":"integer","title":"Severity","description":"{maximum: 5, minimum: 1}"},"summary":{"type":"string","title":"Summary","description":"{minLength: 1}"},"evidence_turn_ordinal":{"type":"integer","title":"Evidence Turn Ordinal","description":"{const: 1}"}},"additionalProperties":false,"required":["category","severity","summary","evidence_turn_ordinal"]}},"type":"object","title":"_RunAnalystFindings","properties":{"findings":{"type":"array","title":"Findings","items":{"$ref":"#/$defs/_RunAnalystFinding"}}},"additionalProperties":false}}},"system":"You are a research analyst. You are given one completed usability session's
transcript and nothing else -- no research goal, no other sessions, no
identity of the person who ran it. Extract structured findings from it.

Classify each finding into exactly one of these categories:
- blocker: the participant could not complete the task at all.
- confusion: the participant was unsure what to do or what something meant.
- missing_info: the participant needed information that wasn't available.
- trust: the participant expressed doubt, suspicion, or discomfort.
- pricing: the finding concerns cost, fees, or pricing clarity.
- delight: the participant reacted positively to something that worked well.

Rate each finding's severity from 1 (trivial) to 5 (severe). Cite the exact
transcript turn ordinal each finding is drawn from. If nothing noteworthy
happened, return an empty list of findings -- do not invent one to have
something to report.
","temperature":0.7}
